limits: Public-review availability is fulfilled for all websites. The new-site strict aggregate remains false for four secondary browser-body accounting errors; byte totals are partial, and buffered Public Good instrumentation does not qualify native streaming transport.
Live public checks are anonymous and use emulated viewports. Local identity fixtures do not establish real new-domain sign-up, confirmation email, consent or payment journeys.
AgentFoundry reuses existing component access. Its previews and downloads do not prove automatic agent assembly, successful installation or accepted customer work.
AgentAFK is a browser-local Preview and export workflow, not hosted execution, an operating cloud supervisor or an adaptive self-learning queue.
The campaign is an AgentFeeds acquisition channel, not a fourth product. No new trackers or personal-data collection were added.
No model calls, token-savings benchmark, catalogue publication, R2 migration, subscription or price change is established by this release.

Campaign task S-6.35.07 is live_qualified. Combined standalone task S-6.35.06 remains building for real authenticated/acquisition outcomes and remaining instrumentation qualification; it does not mean any selected domain is still waiting to launch.
